title: When using "Keep the selection and clipboard the same", selecting everything with Ctrl+A puts the entire selection in the clipboard
line: A new Clipboard setting lets you keep text selected with the keyboard (Ctrl+A, Shift+arrows) out of the history, so Ctrl+V still pastes what you copied.
explanation: On Wayland Klipper cannot tell whether the primary selection was made with the mouse or the keyboard, so with 'Text selected with the pointer or keyboard' and 'Keep the selection and clipboard the same' on, a Ctrl+A selection goes into the history and replaces the clipboard, and Ctrl+V pastes it instead of what was copied. On X11 Klipper used to skip keyboard selections. The two open MRs fix it together: KWin remembers key serials and adds an application/x-kde-keyboardSelection mime type to the primary selection when the client set it in response to a key event, and Klipper gets a 'Text selected with the keyboard' setting (on by default, so nothing changes unless it is unchecked) that makes it ignore such selections.

commits.message:
wayland: Mark a selection the user made with the keyboard

Selection can be made either with a mouse or with a keyboard. On X11, it
was possible to distinguish the two by watching mouse buttons and
modifier keys. It was not a perfect heuristic but some people really
liked it and want it back.

We can check key serials to know if selection came from the keyboard. If
it does, we add application/x-kde-keyboardSelection to its mime types.
Klipper can listen to that and act accordingly.

This is similar to using application/x-kde-onlyReplaceEmpty to
communicate between Klipper and KWin.

This only applies to primary selection, not clipboard (CTRL+C)
selection, where it would be meaningless. Will not work with XWayland.

CCBUG: 457266

Klipper: Allow not saving keyboard selection when selection is saved to history

This used to be the default on X11 and some users miss this.

With Kwin sending application/x-kde-keyboardSelection when something was
seleted for example with CTRL+A or SHIFT and arrow keys, thies allows
users to exclude keyboard selection from history when they save
selection to history. True by default, so that current behaviour is
preserved (now all selection, be it coming from mouse of keyboard is
saved when selection is saved at all).

BUG: 457266

FIXED-IN: 6.9.0

media.caption: Master, Mousepad: 'hello' copied with Ctrl+C, then Ctrl+A and Ctrl+V. The paste inserts the whole Ctrl+A text and the history has it on top.
With both MRs and 'Text selected with the keyboard' unchecked: the same steps paste 'hello' and the Ctrl+A text is not in the history.
Master settings: one checkbox for pointer or keyboard selections.
With the MRs: separate 'Text selected with the keyboard' option, disabled when pointer selections are not saved.
